transcript.content: Hello, I'm Dr. Smith. It's nice to meet you; could you tell me what brings you in to see me today?

Hi, Dr. Smith. Well, I'm here because for the past year, I've been trying to prove that someone in the clinic system is changing or holding back parts of my dad's lab results. I work as a phlebotomist, so I know how these things work. And no matter how many doctors or family members tell me the numbers are fine, I know the chart doesn't match what I actually saw. It's just... it's really wearing me down trying to get someone to look at the truth.
Do you ever hear voices or see things that other people around you cannot perceive?

No, nothing like that. I don't hear voices or see things that aren't there. My hearing and vision are perfectly fine. I just... I know what I saw on those initial lab reports before they were changed. But no, no voices or anything.
Do you have any known medical conditions or are you currently taking any prescribed medications?
No, I don't have any medical conditions. Um, and I'm not taking any prescription medications, either. Physically, I'm perfectly healthy.
Do you feel that anyone else, such as the doctors or your family members, are involved in a plot to hide the truth from you?

No, I don't think that. I don't think my family or the doctors I've spoken to are part of any kind of plot. It's more just... they don't believe me. 

My family just thinks I'm stressed out from work, and the doctors are just looking at the chart in the computer system and trusting what it says. They don't realize the numbers they're looking at have been altered. So they aren't trying to hide anything from me, they just don't know they're looking at bad information.
Are there any other situations or events in your life that you feel strongly about, even though others have told you that your interpretation of them is incorrect?

No, not really. Um, I can't think of anything else. It's really just this one specific issue with the lab reports. 

Everything else in my life is completely normal. I go to work, I do my job drawing blood, I come home. There aren't any other... situations or events where people are telling me I'm wrong about what happened. It's just this.
Has this intense focus on your father's lab reports caused you to miss work, lose sleep, or experience difficulties in your relationships with your family members?

Well, I haven't missed any work or lost sleep, no. But... it has caused some issues. My family has actually started leaving me out of some of the appointment planning, which is frustrating. 

And at work, I mean, I still go to all my shifts, but I feel like I'm no longer being considered for lab supervision. People there think I make record issues too confrontational. I guess they just don't like it when I point out that things don't add up. So, yeah, it has affected things a bit.
When you talk to your colleagues or family about these lab results, do you ever find yourself becoming so preoccupied with the topic that you have trouble focusing on or finishing other daily tasks?

No, not really. I mean, I definitely think about it a lot, but it doesn't stop me from getting things done. Outside of the dispute about my dad's records, everything else is pretty much business as usual. 

I still keep all my phlebotomy shifts, I pay my bills on time, I take care of myself... I manage all my normal day-to-day responsibilities just fine. It's not like I'm sitting around staring at the wall all day. I just want the truth about his labs to come out, but I'm still living my life.
How long have you been concerned about these lab results?

It's been about a year now. Um, yeah, right around a year. It all started when my dad's medical problems began and he had to start going in for frequent labs and appointments. That's when I first started looking at the reports and realized what was going on.
Have you ever felt that there is a specific person, a group of people, or perhaps a computer algorithm that is actively targeting or manipulating your access to these specific records?

Yes. I know for a fact that someone inside the clinic system is changing or holding back parts of my dad's lab results. That's actually the main reason I'm here. 

For the past year, I've been trying to prove it. No matter how many doctors or even my own family members tell me the numbers are fine, I know what I saw. The chart just doesn't match the original data. It's... it's really wearing me down, honestly, constantly having to fight this when I know the records are being manipulated.
Have you ever felt that you have any special abilities, or have you ever suspected that someone close to you might be unfaithful, or that you might be suffering from an undiagnosed physical illness?

No, definitely not. I don't have any... special abilities or anything like that. And no, I don't suspect anyone of cheating on me. As for my own health, I'm perfectly fine. I don't think I have any hidden illnesses. 

Like I said, my only concern is what's happening with my dad's records. It doesn't have anything to do with me being sick or having powers or anything else. I'm just looking at the data in front of me.
